74     def debit(
75         self,
76         channel_id: str,
77         amount_usd: float,
78         receipt_id: str = "",
79         requester_wallet: str = "",
80         secret: str = "",
81     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
82         """Deduct from a channel (called during invoke).
83 
84         Args:
85             receipt_id: Unique ID for replay protection.
86             requester_wallet: authenticated caller wallet (defense-in-depth; must match owner
87                 when supplied).
88             secret: the per-channel debit secret returned at open. Always required;
89                 legacy channels with no stored hash fail closed.
90         """
91         # Bill with a ceiling so a positive sub-cent price is never served free.
92         amount_cents = channels._dollars_to_cents_bill(amount_usd)
93         # Replay protection is a property of the function, not of its callers: a debit that
94         # moves money must name the operation it pays for, so a retried or duplicated request
95         # cannot be charged twice. (Every caller passes one today; this keeps it that way.)
96         if amount_cents > 0 and not receipt_id:
97             return {"error": "receipt_id is required for a debit"}
98 
99         with self._lock, self._get_conn() as conn:
100             row = conn.execute(
101                 "SELECT * FROM channels WHERE channel_id = ?", (channel_id,)
102             ).fetchone()
103             if not row:
104                 return {"error": "channel not found"}
105             if row["status"] != "open":
106                 return {"error": "channel not open"}
107 
108             # A channel id or public wallet cannot authorize spending. No stored secret
109             # means ownership cannot be proved, so legacy channels must fail closed.
110             stored_hash = (row["secret_hash"] if "secret_hash" in row.keys() else "") or ""
111             if not stored_hash or not secret or not hmac.compare_digest(stored_hash, channels._hash_secret(secret)):
112                 return {"error": "unauthorized: invalid or missing channel secret"}
113 
114             # Defense-in-depth: if the caller's wallet is known, it must own the channel.
115             if requester_wallet and row["wallet"] and not channels._wallet_matches(
116                 row["wallet"], requester_wallet
117             ):
118                 return {"error": "unauthorized: wallet does not match channel owner"}
119 
120             balance_cents = row["balance_cents"]
121             if amount_cents > balance_cents:
122                 return {
123                     "error": "insufficient balance",
124                     "needed": amount_usd,
125                     "balance": channels._cents_to_dollars(balance_cents),
126                 }
127 
128             # Replay protection
129             if receipt_id:
130                 existing = conn.execute(
131                     "SELECT 1 FROM debited_receipts WHERE receipt_id = ?",
132                     (receipt_id,),
133                 ).fetchone()
134                 if existing:
135                     return {"error": "receipt already processed (replay rejected)"}
136                 if not _insert_once(
137                     conn,
138                     "INSERT INTO debited_receipts (receipt_id, channel_id, amount_cents, timestamp) "
139                     "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
140                     (receipt_id, channel_id, amount_cents, channels._now_iso()),
141                 ):
142                     return {"error": "receipt already processed (replay rejected)"}
143 
144             # One conditional statement moves the money (see _move).
145             if not _move(
146                 conn,
147                 "UPDATE channels SET balance_cents = balance_cents - ?, used_cents = used_cents + ? "
148                 "WHERE channel_id = ? AND status = 'open' AND balance_cents >= ?",
149                 (amount_cents, amount_cents, channel_id, amount_cents),
150             ):
151                 return _lost_race(conn, channel_id, amount_usd)
152             new_balance = _balance_cents(conn, channel_id)
153             conn.commit()
154 
155             remaining = channels._cents_to_dollars(new_balance)
156 
157         return {"ok": True, "channel_id": channel_id, "remaining_balance": remaining}

159     def hold(
160         self,
161         channel_id: str,
162         amount_usd: float,
163         receipt_id: str,
164         requester_wallet: str = "",
165         secret: str = "",
166     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
167         """Reserve funds for a Pay-on-Verified invoke (auth leg of auth/capture).
168 
169         Same authorization as debit (channel secret + wallet defense) — the buyer
170         authorizes the reservation while their secret is in-request, so the later
171         capture/release can run from a background worker WITHOUT the secret.
172         Balance drops immediately: a pending verification can never be double-spent.
173         """
174         if not receipt_id:
175             return {"error": "receipt_id is required for a hold"}
176         amount_cents = channels._dollars_to_cents_bill(amount_usd)
177 
178         with self._lock, self._get_conn() as conn:
179             row = conn.execute(
180                 "SELECT * FROM channels WHERE channel_id = ?", (channel_id,)
181             ).fetchone()
182             if not row:
183                 return {"error": "channel not found"}
184             if row["status"] != "open":
185                 return {"error": "channel not open"}
186 
187             stored_hash = (row["secret_hash"] if "secret_hash" in row.keys() else "") or ""
188             if not stored_hash or not secret or not hmac.compare_digest(stored_hash, channels._hash_secret(secret)):
189                 return {"error": "unauthorized: invalid or missing channel secret"}
190             if requester_wallet and row["wallet"] and not channels._wallet_matches(
191                 row["wallet"], requester_wallet
192             ):
193                 return {"error": "unauthorized: wallet does not match channel owner"}
194 
195             balance_cents = row["balance_cents"]
196             if amount_cents > balance_cents:
197                 return {
198                     "error": "insufficient balance",
199                     "needed": amount_usd,
200                     "balance": channels._cents_to_dollars(balance_cents),
201                 }
202 
203             # Replay protection — a receipt nonce may be used by at most one
204             # debit OR one hold, ever.
205             for table in ("debited_receipts", "channel_holds"):
206                 existing = conn.execute(
207                     f"SELECT 1 FROM {table} WHERE receipt_id = ?", (receipt_id,)
208                 ).fetchone()
209                 if existing:
210                     return {"error": "receipt already processed (replay rejected)"}
211 
212             if not _insert_once(
213                 conn,
214                 "INSERT INTO channel_holds (receipt_id, channel_id, amount_cents, status, created_at) "
215                 "VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'held', ?)",
216                 (receipt_id, channel_id, amount_cents, channels._now_iso()),
217             ):
218                 return {"error": "receipt already processed (replay rejected)"}
219             if not _move(
220                 conn,
221                 "UPDATE channels SET balance_cents = balance_cents - ? "
222                 "WHERE channel_id = ? AND status = 'open' AND balance_cents >= ?",
223                 (amount_cents, channel_id, amount_cents),
224             ):
225                 return _lost_race(conn, channel_id, amount_usd)
226             new_balance = _balance_cents(conn, channel_id)
227             conn.commit()
228             remaining = channels._cents_to_dollars(new_balance)
229 
230         return {
231             "ok": True,
232             "channel_id": channel_id,
233             "remaining_balance": remaining,
234             "held_usd": channels._cents_to_dollars(amount_cents),
235         }

380     def refund(
381         self,
382         channel_id: str,
383         amount_usd: float,
384         requester_wallet: str = "",
385         secret: str = "",
386     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
387         """Reverse a recorded debit back into the channel's spendable balance.
388 
389         In-ledger correction only — no funds move. Only allowed on open channels.
390 
391         Authorization mirrors debit(): a stored secret and its matching credential are
392         required, and a supplied requester_wallet must own the channel.
393         Without that, the only thing standing between a leaked channel id and a
394         rewritten balance was the deposit cap.
395         """
396         try:
397             amount_usd = float(amount_usd)
398         except (TypeError, ValueError):
399             return {"error": "refund amount must be a number"}
400         if not math.isfinite(amount_usd):
401             return {"error": "refund amount must be a finite number"}
402         amount_cents = channels._dollars_to_cents(amount_usd)
403 
404         with self._lock, self._get_conn() as conn:
405             row = conn.execute(
406                 "SELECT * FROM channels WHERE channel_id = ?", (channel_id,)
407             ).fetchone()
408             if not row:
409                 return {"error": "channel not found"}
410             if row["status"] != "open":
411                 return {"error": f"channel is {row['status']} — refund only allowed on open channels"}
412 
413             stored_hash = (row["secret_hash"] if "secret_hash" in row.keys() else "") or ""
414             if not stored_hash or not secret or not hmac.compare_digest(stored_hash, channels._hash_secret(secret)):
415                 return {"error": "unauthorized: invalid or missing channel secret"}
416             if requester_wallet and row["wallet"] and not channels._wallet_matches(
417                 row["wallet"], requester_wallet
418             ):
419                 return {"error": "unauthorized: wallet does not match channel owner"}
420 
421             # Cap at what was actually SPENT. `original - balance` (the old cap) also
422             # counted cents reserved by an unresolved hold: refunding those put them back
423             # in the spendable balance while the hold could still be captured, minting
424             # value the deposit never covered.
425             # A publisher's cash-backed accrual is funded from this capture. Keep
426             # its backing spent so a reversal cannot also promise it to the buyer.
427             max_refund = row["used_cents"] - row["publisher_backed_cents"]
428             amount_cents = min(amount_cents, max_refund)
429             if amount_cents <= 0:
430                 return {"error": "refund amount would exceed recorded spend"}
431 
432             if not _move(
433                 conn,
434                 "UPDATE channels SET balance_cents = balance_cents + ?, used_cents = used_cents - ? "
435                 "WHERE channel_id = ? AND status = 'open' AND used_cents - publisher_backed_cents >= ?",
436                 (amount_cents, amount_cents, channel_id, amount_cents),
437             ):
438                 current = conn.execute(
439                     "SELECT status FROM channels WHERE channel_id = ?", (channel_id,),
440                 ).fetchone()
441                 if current and current["status"] != "open":
442                     return {"error": f"channel is {current['status']} — refund only allowed on open channels"}
443                 return {"error": "refund amount would exceed recorded spend"}
444             new_balance = _balance_cents(conn, channel_id)
445             conn.commit()
446 
447             remaining = channels._cents_to_dollars(new_balance)
448 
449         return {"ok": True, "channel_id": channel_id, "remaining_balance": remaining}
